title: Oxidean docs site manifest (manifest_version 1)
description: Contract for the curated docs/site/ subtree in Oxidean product repos. Validated by the docs-manifest CLI; packed into docs-<version>.tar.gz release assets consumed by oxidean.dev.

slug.description: URL path segment for this product's docs (lowercase, digits, hyphens).

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo that owns this docs subtree.

tag_pattern.description: Release tag glob whose releases carry docs bundles (e.g. "v*", "ox-v*").

version.description: Docs version. Must equal the release tag minus its non-semver prefix (e.g. tag ox-v0.4.2 -> "0.4.2").

pages.description: Ordered sidebar tree. Each item has a label plus exactly one of link (bundle-relative slug, leading and trailing /) or items (nested children).

assets.description: Glob patterns (doublestar ** supported) for non-page files shipped in the bundle. Non-page files matching no pattern are orphans and fail validation.

link.description: Bundle-relative page slug: "/" for the index, "/section/page/" for nested pages.
